name: Invoices
description: Line-item invoices, quotes, and credit notes (doc_type on one shared schema): owner-scoped CRUD, guarded status lifecycle (draft/sent/paid/partial/overdue/void), and a HANDLES totals handler (system_invoice_totals) that stamps subtotal/tax/total/balance from invoice_lines in integer cents on every line change. Deferred to a later slice: auto-numbered sequences per doc_type (invoice_counters + a closed invoices create route), the tokenized public/printable /i/{token} view, order-to-invoice conversion, and partial-payment recording (amount_paid_cents exists but nothing writes it yet). See plan/vocabulary/20-invoice-spec.md. subtotal_cents/tax_cents/total_cents/balance_due_cents/line_total_cents/line_tax_cents are deliberately NOT schema read_only -- see objects/system/invoice_totals.py's module docstring for why (update_collection_record has no read_only write exception, so a truly read_only field could never be re-stamped). The invoice permalink /invoices/{invoice_id:uuid} is now a seeded 59 detail view (site_view_render): a composed page of three generic block renderers -- an editable+deletable `detail` block (the invoice; the status field's own 10-flow transition guards enforce legal moves through the owner edit form, so no one-click Send/Void buttons are built, the same make-it-basic trade app-forum's pin/lock retrofit made), a `related` block (invoice_lines by invoice_id -- lines stay their own relational collection, never embedded, because they are the thing receipts/notes attach to later), and a `form` block with fixed:{invoice_id:$record_id} (Add Line, FK locked to the page's invoice). No bespoke per-invoice page or hand-written money-totals table -- the detail block's own /form cents formatting renders subtotal/tax/total/paid/balance correctly with no custom JS. No public/anonymous path in this slice; plan/vocabulary/20-invoice-spec.md's tokenized /i/{public_token} view is still a later slice. 0.5.0 adds the customer payment portal: /pay/{token}, an unguessable capability URL that lets the person who owes money see the invoice and how to pay it WITHOUT an account. The customer is not a user of this system, and a signup wall between a willing payer and their money is why invoices age. The token is schema read_only so no client can choose its own -- a predictable capability URL is not a capability -- and system_invoice_portal_link mints one the moment an invoice leaves draft, because a link that only appears once an invoice goes overdue exists only for the customers who already failed to pay. Dunning emails now carry the link, which is what finally makes them actionable. There is no card processing yet, so the page shows the business's own payment instructions rather than a Pay button that does nothing: a link that lies is worse than no link. 0.6.0 deletes the bespoke /invoices list page object: it was ~90 lines of chrome around two generator calls with no business logic of its own, and is now a seeded VIEW record over the same `list` block the invoice detail's own retrofit already established the precedent for.

schedules.description: Flip sent invoices to overdue once past due, and escalate dunning.
